fields.name: indicator
fields.description_en: [String] The specific computation applied. There are 5 provided in the dataset, namely the highest rate in the month ('high'), lowest rate in the month ('low'), the average across trading days in the month ('avg'), the rate on the first trading day of the month ('start'), and the rate on the last trading day of the month ('end').

It should be noted that the ringgit is the numerator, so higher values indicate a depreciation while lower values indicate an appreciation.

fields.name: gdp
fields.description_en: [Float, RM mil] The total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. The values are at current prices.
fields.description_ms: [Apung, RM juta] Jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Nilai adalah pada harga semasa.

fields.name: gni
fields.description_en: [Float, RM mil] The total value of the production of the nationals of the country, whether they are in residence in Malaysia or not. Mechnically, it is defined as GDP plus net factor incomes from abroad. The values are at current prices for that year.
fields.description_ms: [Apung, RM juta] Jumlah nilai pengeluaran oleh warganegara Malaysia, sama ada mereka bermastautin dalam Malaysia atau tidak. Secara mekanikal, PNK boleh didefinisikan sebagai KDNK tambah pendapatan faktor bersih dari luar negara. Nilai adalah pada harga semasa bagi tahun tersebut.

It should be noted that although LULUCF values can, in principle, be positive (representing emissions) or negative (representing removals), the values for Malaysia are all negative.

Harus diingati bahawa walaupun nilai LULUCF secara prinsipnya boleh positif (mewakili pelepasan) atau negatif (mewakili penyingkiran), nilai bagi Malaysia adalah semua negatif.
